result.summary: Removes the obsolete FillableSigningProvider class and inlines its key and script management directly into LegacyDataSPKM to support legacy wallet migration. Replaces remaining usages of FillableSigningProvider across unit tests, fuzz harnesses, benchmarks, and bitcoin-tx with FlatSigningProvider. Adds an explicit check in SignStep to reject signing P2SH redeem scripts exceeding MAX_SCRIPT_ELEMENT_SIZE (520 bytes).
result.problem: FillableSigningProvider was originally extracted to provide an encapsulated keystore for the legacy wallet. With the legacy wallet removed, maintaining a separate keystore class with its own recursive mutex is unnecessary technical debt when its only production role is supporting legacy wallet migration in LegacyDataSPKM.
evidence: PR description: "Since the legacy wallet is removed, there is no need to keep it around as a separate class. Instead, the things that it was doing can be inlined into LegacyDataSPKM where the functionality is actually being used to support migrating legacy wallets."
Commit dc10efcaf6: "sign: Do not sign SCRIPTHASH redeemScripts > 520 bytes" replaces the implicit 520-byte script size check previously enforced by FillableSigningProvider::AddCScript.
result.scope_notes: Most of the diff is mechanical test and fuzz harness updates replacing FillableSigningProvider calls with direct FlatSigningProvider map insertions.
result.card: Removes the obsolete FillableSigningProvider class, inlining its key and script storage directly into LegacyDataSPKM for legacy wallet migration. Replaces remaining usages in tests, benchmarks, and the bitcoin-tx tool with FlatSigningProvider. To retain signing validation previously enforced by FillableSigningProvider::AddCScript, SignStep is updated to explicitly reject P2SH redeem scripts exceeding 520 bytes. This cleans up leftover keystore abstractions following the removal of the legacy wallet.

risk.why: A mistake in SignStep or key/script lookup in LegacyDataSPKM could cause transaction signing failures or corrupt legacy wallet migration.
